# FORM Build-System Maintenance

This document applies to build-system maintenance, not routine configuration,
building, or testing; see `AGENTS.md` for the shared workflow.

Before changing configuration behavior, dependencies, installation, or supported
platforms, read `INSTALL`. Also check `README.md` when the change affects its
build instructions or dependency summary. When needed, check available configure
options with `./configure --help`.

## Maintained Inputs and Generated Files

- Maintained Autotools inputs include `configure.ac`, `Makefile.am`, and files
  under `m4/`; do not edit generated files such as `configure`, `Makefile.in`,
  `config.h`, or `aclocal.m4`.
- When changing feature or platform detection, edit `configure.ac`. When adding,
  removing, or renaming a build input, update the owning `Makefile.am`.
- When adding source, test, or other files intended for release archives, add
  them to the appropriate source or distribution list. Do not add ignored
  generated Autotools outputs.
- `extern/zstd` is a Git submodule that provides the zstd zlib wrapper. When
  changing zstd build support, keep the checks in `configure.ac`, the `WITHZSTD`
  source selection in `sources/Makefile.am`, and source-distribution contents in
  sync.
- Maintenance guidance used only in Git checkouts is excluded from release
  archives.
- `sources/version.h` and documentation version fragments are generated by
  `scripts/git-version-gen.sh`. Do not hard-code a development version into
  generated output.

## Verification

- After changing `configure.ac`, any `Makefile.am`, or files under `m4/`, run
  `autoreconf -i`, configure in a clean or otherwise suitable out-of-source
  build directory, and build the affected targets.
- When changing the `make check` integration, run
  `make -C path/to/build-dir check` in addition to any direct `check/check.rb`
  runs.
- Run `make -C path/to/build-dir distcheck` for changes that affect distribution
  contents, installation, release versioning, or generated documentation.
